messages:
alex: Heads-up — BlueKite onboarding hitting 401 then a cascade of 429s during Node SDK warmup. Seeing this right after deploy, parallel instances all spike.

maria-cs: They’re using SDK v1.4.3 in a serverless warmup (Netlify). Reported first 401 at 12:03 then repeated 429s for ~6 minutes. No other tenants affected.

jordan-eng: 401 -> 429 pattern usually means ephemeral token refresh stampede. Can we get headers + `sdk-version` and `x-client-timestamp` values from their logs? Also confirm they aren't creating a new SDK client per request.

alex: Paste of their log snippet:
```
12:03:10 GET /v1/preflight 401 x-client-ts=1710000000 sdk=v1.4.3
12:03:11 POST /v1/generate 429 quota_exceeded
12:03:12 POST /v1/generate 429 quota_exceeded
12:03:13 POST /v1/generate 429 quota_exceeded
12:04:00 GET /v1/preflight 200 token_issued
```
They said token TTL was ~10s on their side.

sam-devex: If TTL is ~10s and all instances refresh at once you get a thundering herd. Short-term: recommend staggered refresh (splay) + exponential backoff. Mid-term: bump ephemeral TTL to >=60s. SDK has config knobs: `refreshWindowMs`, `refreshSplayMs`, `maxRefreshRetries`.

sam-devex: Example config to push to them:
```
const client = Redwood.init({
  apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY,
  refreshWindowMs: 30000, // start refresh 30s before expiry
  refreshSplayMs: 300000, // randomize up to 5m
  maxRefreshRetries: 5
});
```

jordan-eng: Also advise reusing SDK client across coldstart function instances if possible. If they must re-init per instance, introduce a short local in-memory cache to carry token across concurrent invocations. And enable keepalive on their HTTP client.

alex: They run ~50 concurrent cold starts during release. Asked for short-term mitigation: can we temporarily raise tenant burst allowance or apply a soft-rate so their warmup doesn't trip global limits?

maria-cs: I pinged product for a short-lived bump. @ops-bot can you open a temp quota patch for tenant `bluekite-team` and add monitoring for 2 hours? Will coordinate rollback after.

ops-bot: Ticket #INC-8742 opened — temporary +30 rps applied to tenant `bluekite-team` for 2h starting 2025-11-12T12:08Z. Patch ID: patch-20251112-8742. Monitoring dashboard: https://internal.redwood/mon/INC-8742

sam-devex: Also tell them to upgrade to SDK v1.5.0 — it includes preflight coalescing and randomized refresh by default. Share the small init snippet and link to release notes.

alex: BlueKite confirmed after the quota patch and upgrading to v1.5.0 the 429 volume dropped ~95% and their warmup completed. They did report one remaining 401 at 12:21 which looked like a clock skew on one edge node.

jordan-eng: One lingering 401 suggests a ~clock skew tolerance issue. Recommend they enable `clockSkewTolerance` (3s) or sync NTP on their instances. We'll note it in the RCA.

maria-cs: I'll prepare a short enablement doc (playbook + config examples) and share with BlueKite PM. Also adding this as a renewal risk flag until we observe 48h of clean metrics.

alex: I'll compile the thread + actions and send to BlueKite ops. Follow-up in 24h to confirm. :thumbsup:
